dan_sales: Quick handoff — LyraAI (mid-market) signed last week. Moving to CS for activation. Key contract: 12mo, starts 2026-04-01. Renewal flagged as "high attention" because they asked for usage-based cap and custom SLA. Primary contacts: Sarah (Lyra, PM) and Tom (Lyra, infra).

maria_csm: Thanks Dan. Can you paste the note about SSO and data residency? we need to confirm before kickoff.

dan_sales: SSO via Okta is confirmed, SP-initiated. They also requested logs retained for 13 months (legal). I attached the signed SOW in the sales folder. Also: they plan an internal pilot with 3 prod routes first 6 weeks.

aj_support: Noted. Two support flags: (1) Lyra previously reported a model mismatch on long-context prompts during eval — engineering patched a quant mismatch (PR #482) but we should watch regressions. (2) They want custom metrics in Console (token breakdown by route). Those may need eng work.

joey_cs_ops: Suggested kickoff plan: Week 0 — kickoff + SSO test; Week 1 — pilot onboarding + training; Week 3 — ops review + baseline metrics; Week 6 — expand to prod routes. I'll create calendar invites. Owner: maria_csm (overall), aj_support (support lead), nina_se (technical enablement).

nina_se: I can run a 90-min enablement deep-dive for their infra and prompt engineers. Need their example prompts and expected outputs ahead of time. Also can share a short runbook for our on-prem private deploy path if they request.

maria_csm: Renewal risk notes: they negotiated a 10% price floor tied to 6-month usage. If pilot underperforms, there's a strong chance they'll push to shorter term or cancel. Recommend weekly health checks during pilot and a 30/60/90 usage forecast doc. I'll draft and share by EOD tomorrow.

onboard-bot: CHECKLIST: SSO verified -> yes; SOW uploaded -> yes; Contact aliases added -> yes; Initial billing verified -> pending.

aj_support: Quick tech note — support runbook: add alert for token error rate > 0.8% and latencies > 1.2s p95 for their prod routes. I'll add those to the monitor. Also capturing their feedback channel: lyra-support@redwood (alias).

dan_sales: Thanks team. Sales will keep exec channel updated but moving to CS ops now. @maria_csm please confirm kickoff invite when ready.

maria_csm: Will do. Action items summary: 1) maria_csm: draft 30/60/90 usage forecast + weekly health cadence (due +2 days). 2) joey_cs_ops: create invites & shared calendar (due +1 day). 3) aj_support: create monitors and triage runbook (due +3 days). 4) nina_se: prep enablement deck + runbook (due +4 days). 5) onboard-bot: mark billing verified when finance confirms. If any blockers, flag here and I'll escalate to Dan. :thumbsup:
